[loop rollup] Session-open checklist (2 items). Do BEFORE other work:
- [loop] portal jci_taipei light=red score=35 — 下次 session 對照 agent-status 修合規。
- [loop] 無 park 檔 — 里程碑寫：python C:\ai_workspace\_skill\engines\goal_compact.py park jci_taipei

When done: python %AI_WORKSPACE%\_skill\engines\inbox.py ack jci_taipei <this-id>
